## Setup

```{cv_data <- load_cv_data(}
  data_location = data_location,

)

names(cv_data)
```

```{r}
head(cv_data$entries_data)

```

```{r}
variant <- list(
  name = "draft_ml_engineer",
  language = "en",
  sections = c(
    "intro",
    "recent_professional_experience",
    "education",
    "academic_articles"
  ),
  filters = list(
    include_section_ids = c(
      "recent_professional_experience",
      "education",
      "academic_articles"
    ),
    max_entries_per_section = 3
  ),
  llm = list(
    enabled = FALSE
  )
)
```

```{r}
payload <- build_cv_payload(cv_data, variant)

names(payload)
payload$intro
names(payload$sections)
```

```{r}
payload_filtered <- apply_variant_rules(payload, variant)

names(payload_filtered$sections)
payload_filtered$sections$recent_professional_experience
```

```{r}
preview_section <- function(section_df) {
  if (is.null(section_df) || nrow(section_df) == 0) {
    cat("No entries found.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(section_df))) {
    cat("### ", section_df$title[i], "\n\n", sep = "")
    cat(section_df$institution[i], "\n\n")
    cat(section_df$timeline[i], "\n\n")

    bullets <- section_df$description_bullets[i]
    if (!is.na(bullets) && nzchar(bullets)) {
      cat(bullets, "\n\n")
    }

    cat("\n---\n\n")
  }

  invisible(NULL)
}
```

```{r}
preview_section(payload_filtered$sections$recent_professional_experience)
```
